prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: The kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project outlined a three-phase rollout plan beginning with a discovery phase in April and a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May. Key requirements were identified, including on-premise integration, and two part-time coordinators from the client's operations team will support the pilot. Action items were assigned related to schedule updates, connector documentation, budget proposals, and coordinator confirmations, with a follow-up on pilot results planned for June.
